reason: I'm still working out what my cat will actually eat, so at RM 2.80 I'd pick up three or four pouches at the booth to test, plus the free pack. It's a trial, not a switch - I'm not messaging a Facebook page to reorder when I can grab cat food with the groceries.
objection: After 31 December the booth is gone and the only way to get it is by DM. If my cat does like it, I'm stuck chasing a brand I've never heard of through Instagram messages, with no idea about delivery cost or how long it takes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on a shelf at the supermarket or a pet shop in Miri where I already shop would turn a one-off trial into a regular buy.
